items.question: Which WNBA teams did Candice Wiggins play for?
items.answer: Candice Wiggins played eight WNBA seasons, from 2008 to 2015, for the Minnesota Lynx, Tulsa Shock, Los Angeles Sparks and New York Liberty. The Lynx drafted her third overall in 2008, and she won the 2011 WNBA championship with Minnesota.

items.question: What were Candice Wiggins' WNBA career averages?
items.answer: Candice Wiggins averaged 8.6 points, 2.4 rebounds and 1.9 assists in 221 WNBA regular-season games. As a rookie in 2008 she averaged 15.7 points off the bench and won WNBA Sixth Woman of the Year.

items.question: Where did Candice Wiggins play college basketball?
items.answer: Candice Wiggins played at Stanford and finished as the school's all-time leading scorer with 2,629 points. In 2008 she passed Lisa Leslie as the Pac-10's career scoring leader and won the Wade Trophy as the national player of the year.

items.question: How tall is Candice Wiggins?
items.answer: Basketball-Reference lists Candice Wiggins at 5 feet 11 inches. She played guard.

items.question: Where did Candice Wiggins go to high school?
items.answer: Candice Wiggins played at La Jolla Country Day School in La Jolla, California, and was a McDonald's All-American as a senior.
